record_title: Corner and isolation obstructions in Kumjian--Pask induction--restriction
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. Standard Steinberg-algebra facts about compact-open bisections, open singleton units, and isotropy induction are prior work; the novelty claim is restricted to the correction of arXiv:2609.20230v1, its explicit counterexamples, the exact isolated-unit condition for the proposed point-mass embedding, and the idempotent-corner tensor repair. The complete text of the 2024 Nguyen--Nguyen article was not inspected. The source preprint is recent and may be revised. This record does not claim that every downstream conclusion is false, only that the identified constructions and dependent proofs fail as stated without correction.
